name: After-Party Chemistry
source:
Marina is a second-semester senior who is struggling in AP Chemistry! The dean suspended her from the water polo team until she can raise her grade. How will she change her study habits? Whom will she seek help from? Her chemistry teacher? The class T.A.? A study buddy? Will she be able to raise her grade in time for the Championships? Or will she be spending time wooing her tutor?

[From [url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/after-party-chemistry]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
玛丽娜正值高中毕业年级的第二学期，却在AP化学课上苦苦挣扎！教务主任暂停了她参加水球队的资格，直到成绩提高为止。她会如何改变自己的学习习惯？又会向谁求助？化学老师？班上的助教？一起学习的伙伴？她能在锦标赛开始前把成绩提上去吗？还是会把时间花在追求辅导自己的人身上？

[摘自[url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/after-party-chemistry]itch.io[/url]]
